_comment: operations-record-reconciliation (boards SkDatakwaliteit, SkOrganisatie). OpenRegister finds duplicate applications and services from x-openregister-dedup and merges them reversibly from x-openregister-merge (ADR-045); stackiq declares the rules, re-points its own references after a merge (CatalogueMergeRelinker) and leaves Merged records out of its lists.

recordStatus.title: Record status
recordStatus.description: Active, or Merged once OpenRegister merged this record into another application. A merged record leaves the lists and its page points at the survivor.

mergedInto.title: Merged into
mergedInto.description: The application this record was merged into. Set by stackiq after OpenRegister's merge.

recordStatus.title: Record status
recordStatus.description: Active, or Merged once OpenRegister merged this record into another service. A merged record leaves the lists and its page points at the survivor.

mergedInto.title: Merged into
mergedInto.description: The service this record was merged into. Set by stackiq after OpenRegister's merge.
